title: StraboField Spot
description: JSON Schema for a StraboField Spot — a GeoJSON Feature representing a geological observation. Spots are the core data model of the StraboField application, containing geometry (location), measurements, images, samples, petrology, sedimentary data, 3D structures, fabrics, and other geological observations. Generated from form definitions in /src/assets/forms/.

modified_timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of last modification (auto-updated on every edit)

notesTimestamp.description: Timestamp of when notes were last modified

lat.description: Latitude (set for spots on image basemaps or strat sections)

lng.description: Longitude (set for spots on image basemaps or strat sections)

image_basemap.description: ID of parent image when spot is drawn on an image basemap

strat_section_id.description: ID of parent stratigraphic section when spot is drawn on a strat section

notes.description: Free-form text notes for this spot

nesting.description: Array of spot IDs that are manually nested under this spot

data.description: External URLs and imported CSV tables

max_absolute_age_of_geol_unit.description: Maximum Absolute Age of Geologic Unit (Ma)

min_absolute_age_of_geol_unit.description: Minimum Absolute Age of Geologic Unit (Ma)

trace.description: Trace feature (contacts, structures, geomorphic features on map lines)

site_safety.description: Site safety information for field stops

orientation_data.description: Orientation measurements (planar, linear, and tabular zone orientations)

fault_or_sz.description: Fault Zone or Shear Zone Type

other_fault_or_sz.description: Other Fault Zone or Shear Zone Type

fault_or_sz_type.description: Type of Fault or Shear Zone Boundary

other_fault_or_sz_type.description: Other Fault or Shear Zone Boundary Type

associated_orientation.description: Associated/nested orientation measurements (e.g., lineation on a plane)

scale_of_object.description: Scale and type of object in image (m)

annotated.description: If true, image is used as an image basemap

samples.description: Rock/sediment samples collected at this spot

weather_conditions.description: Describe weather conditions during tephra fall

_3d_structures.description: 3D structural features (folds, faults, tensors, fabrics, other)

fabrics.description: Rock fabric descriptions (fault rock, igneous, metamorphic)

char_plan.description: Characterize what defines the planar fabric

lin_other.description: Characterize what defines the linear fabric

vein_arr_min.description: Mineral(s) that define vein or dike array

grow_vert_ind.description: Growth and/or younging or paleovertical indicators

pet.description: Petrology data (igneous, metamorphic, alteration/ore, fault rocks, minerals, reaction textures)

rock_type.description: List of active rock type categories (e.g., ["igneous", "metamorphic"])

fault_rock.description: Fault and Shear Zone Rock Type

sed.description: Sedimentary data (intervals, bedding, lithologies, structures, interpretations, fossils, diagenesis, strat sections)

laminae_thickness_i_select_more_than_one.description: Laminae Thickness (if variable, select more than one)

lamination_character.description: Lamination Character (if variable, select more than one)

bedding_thickness.description: Bedding Thickness (if variable, select more than one)

bedding_character.description: Bedding character (if variable, select more than one)

shape_of_lower_contacts.description: Shape of lower contact(s) (if variable, select more than one)

character_of_lower_contacts.description: Character of lower contact(s) (if variable, select more than one)

shape_of_upper_contacts.description: Shape of upper contact(s) (if variable, select more than one)

character_of_upper_contacts.description: Character of upper contact(s) (if variable, select more than one)

shape_of_lower_contacts.description: Shape of Lower Contact (if variable, select more than one)

character_of_lower_contacts.description: Character of Lower Contact(s) (if variable, select more than one)

shape_of_upper_contacts.description: Shape of Upper Contact (if variable, select more than one)

character_of_upper_contacts.description: Character of Upper Contact (if variable, select more than one)

lithology_at_bottom_contact.description: Which Lithology is at Bottom Contact?

lithology_at_top_contact.description: Which Lithology is at Top Contact?

structures.description: Sedimentary structures (physical, bedding plane, bioturbation, pedogenic)

paleosol_classification.description: Paleosol Classification (after Soil Survey Staff, 1999; Retallack, 2001)

microbial_reef_or_skelatal_mic.description: Microbial Reef or Skeletal-Microbial Reef Type

other_microbial_or_skeletal_mi.description: Other Microbial or Skeletal Microbial Reef

other_carbonate_desicc_diss.description: Other Carbonate Desiccation and Dissolution Type

depth_from_surface_to_start_of.description: Depth from surface to start of core
